qual: exploratory n=1; length confounded with file type

definition.proposition: E1's loss advantage over E0 shrinks and reverses with document length: E1 is better on short documents (under ~600 tokens) and worse on long ones (over ~1,200 tokens)

scope.dataset: SQ99 out-of-corpus set (330 local Python files) binned by token length
scope.architecture: E1 hybrid (1 attn + 2 SWA-256 + 3 GDN) vs E0 dense (6 attn), v0.3.0 checkpoints

definition.refutation_criteria: A per-position (not per-document) analysis on both in-corpus and out-of-corpus docs, with tuned Phase 2b checkpoints over 3 seeds, shows no dependence of the E1-vs-E10 gap on context position or document length (slope CI including 0)

limitations.text: The length bins are not stored in sq_99.json and no analysis script is committed. The verifier (audit 2026-11-22-2005-b2) recomputed them from data.out_docs[].tokens and data.per_doc_nll: point estimates -3.86/-2.39/-0.56/+1.09% and package-clustered percentile CIs (seed 0) match. The 4-bin cut is post hoc (statistics policy section 4: exploratory), out-of-corpus only (in-corpus docs not binned), single seed, untuned v0.3.0 checkpoints, and length is confounded with file type and package; the proposition's general wording is broader than this scope.

SQ214 result; exploratory, so no status change (statistics-policy section 4)

limitations.text: SQ214 (exploratory, 4 seeds, 20M tokens, one RTX 5090): opening E1's two SWA layers to full context (w1024) makes clean80 bpc WORSE by 1.30% vs w256 (paired t 5.1, df 3, all seeds same sign), and w64 is 0.76% worse. The 'SWA window caps long-doc context' explanation of the >1,200-token reversal loses support; SQ226 (scorer chunking) and SQ219 (context removal) are the next tests.

reason: SQ228 (exploratory, CPU): on the 330 SQ99 out-of-corpus files, 8-gram repeat share correlates 0.48 with log length; in a joint OLS with a package-clustered bootstrap (31 packages) repeat share absorbs ~27% of the log-length coefficient (1.55 -> 1.13 per SD, CI 0.75-1.56). Length survives; repetition is a partial mediator, not a replacement. No status change (statistics-policy section 4).

limitations.text: The length bins were chosen post hoc and the bin analysis is not a committed script; length is confounded with file type (SQ99 card), and SQ214 weakens the SWA-window explanation. Exploratory association in the 330 out-of-corpus files
